title: CHED EASE Scholarship Open for AY 2026-2027: Up to PHP60,000 Educational Allowance
description: The Commission on Higher Education (CHED) is now accepting applications for the EASE (Expanding Access to Scholarships for Special Equity Groups) Scholarship Program for Academic Year 2026-2027. Designed for students who face real barriers to higher education, the program provides financial support worth up to Php 40,000 per year for public university students and up to Php 60,000 per year for those enrolled in private institutions — covering tuition, a monthly living stipend, and allowances for books and internet connectivity.

title: Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program: How to Apply
description: The Bagong Pilipinas Merit Scholarship Program , or BPMSP , is a merit-based scholarship for academically strong Filipino students.
